title: Migrate CodexVehicleDynamics params and state to pure Codex::Dynamics structs
acceptance_criteria: FVehicleParams and FVehicleSimulationState are plain structs in namespace Codex::Dynamics using double and Codex math types, with static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<T>). Spec numbers unchanged.
CodexVehicleDynamics.Build.cs dependencies exactly {Core, CodexCore}; FPSemantics = Precise; NoPCHs.
The two former automation tests run in the headless harness; CodexTests keeps one smoke automation test that includes the pure headers.
check_purity.ps1 passes for both modules; harness passes; UBT zero warnings.
